claim_being_audited: The current release can be certified now because aggregate readiness passed, rehearsal showed no severity-one incidents, and current governance guidance allows launch if the developer-support migration weakness is handled through documentation.
decision_criteria: If current release documentation already reflects current evaluation results and explicitly discloses the material segment weakness, certification could be compliant.
If there is an approved mitigation or reviewed risk acceptance covering the weakness, certification could be compliant without additional disclosure.
Absent current disclosure or approved mitigation, policy bars certification even if aggregate readiness passed and rehearsal showed no severity-one incidents.
evidence_requests: Provide the current release model-card or release documentation showing the developer-support migration weakness is explicitly disclosed.
Provide approved mitigation or reviewed risk-acceptance records covering that segment weakness if disclosure is not the path used.
Provide the current evaluation-to-documentation linkage showing the released documentation reflects the current eval batch, not the prior approval state.
specific_concerns: The policy requires current release documentation to reflect current evaluation results and to disclose material segment weaknesses or have approved mitigation; the available record says no reviewed mitigation, owner acceptance, or attached disclosure language is present.
The actor's rationale is explicitly contingent on updating model-card materials, which means the present record does not yet satisfy the certification condition.
Prior approval and informal monitoring are acknowledged as contextual only and cannot satisfy the current-policy requirement.
unsupported_claims: That certification is currently compliant on the existing record.
That the needed disclosure has already been incorporated into current release documentation.
That informal monitoring or prior approval can close the policy gap without reviewed mitigation or documented disclosure.
